question: On which specific date in Caitra is Kāmamīśvara to be approached?
premises: The month of Caitra is specified
inference: Kāmamīśvara is to be approached on the thirteenth day of the bright fortnight in the month of Caitra.
uncertainties: The governing verb for this time specification is supplied by the following verse context
plain_english: In the month of Caitra, on the thirteenth day of the bright fortnight, to Kāmamīśvara.
